title: Site-point inverse-image comparison with its unit-germ formula
statement: Let $C,D$ be categories with Grothendieck topologies $J,K$, and let $F:C\to D$ be a representably flat continuous functor which preserves covering sieves. Let $\Phi$ be a point of $(D,K)$: a functor $\Phi:D\to\mathbf{Set}_{w}$ whose category of elements is cofiltered and $w$-initially small and for which covering sieves act jointly surjectively. Assume that the category of elements of $\Phi\circ F$ is $w$-initially small. Let $A$ be a category with products and colimits of size $w$, and assume that restriction $F_*:\operatorname{Sh}(K,A)\to\operatorname{Sh}(J,A)$ has a left adjoint $F^*$. The composite lift functor defines the point $\Phi_F$ on $(C,J)$. There is a natural isomorphism $b:(\Phi_F)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}\Phi^*\circ F^*$ of fibre functors on $A$-valued sheaves. For every $H\in\operatorname{Sh}(J,A)$, object $U\in C$ and $x\in\Phi(FU)$, its component satisfies $b_H\circ\operatorname{germ}_{U,x}=\operatorname{germ}_{FU,x}\circ\eta_{H,U}$, where $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to F_*F^*$ is the adjunction unit and germs are the coprojections into the corresponding neighbourhood colimits.

proof.text: Use Mathlib CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.comap and sheafFiberComapIso (Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Point/Comap.lean:41-75). The skyscraper functors for the composite lift functor agree definitionally, so uniqueness of their left adjoints gives b. The existing theorem CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.toPresheafFiber_sheafFiberComapIso_hom_app (WeilConjectures/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Point/Comap.lean:58-80) is exactly the displayed unit-germ identity; its proof computes the mate of the identity of skyscraper functors and projects the skyscraper unit to x. These are existing proved declarations, with no new Lean statement or unproved obligation.
